cases.sentence: Иисус, сын Навин, тайно послал из ___ двух лазутчиков.
cases.translation: Joshua the son of Nun secretly sent two men out of the camp.
cases.explain: The preposition из (out of/from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Они отправились и пришли в ___ блудницы по имени Раав.
cases.translation: They went and came into the house of a prostitute named Rahab.
cases.explain: The preposition в (into) governing motion takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Царю Иерихона донесли, какие-то израилетяне пришли сюда, чтобы разведать эту ___.
cases.translation: The king of Jericho was told men had come to spy out the land.
cases.explain: The verb разведать (to spy out) takes the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Они отправились и пришли в дом блудницы по имени ___ и остались там ночевать.
cases.translation: They went and came into the house of a prostitute named Rahab and slept there.
cases.explain: The name Раав in apposition describing the house owner stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: А она отвела их на ___ и спрятала среди разложенных там снопов льна.
cases.translation: She brought them up to the roof and hid them among the stalks of flax.
cases.explain: The verb отвела (brought/led) takes the accusative case indicating motion to a location.

cases.sentence: Я знаю, что Господь отдал эту ___ вам.
cases.translation: I know that the Lord has given you this land.
cases.explain: The verb отдал (gave) takes the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Преследователи бросились в погоню за лазутчиками по ___, что ведет к бродам на Иордане.
cases.translation: The pursuers rushed after the spies along the road that led to the fords of the Jordan.
cases.explain: The preposition по (along) in the sense of 'along a road' takes the dative case.

cases.sentence: Она спустила их по веревке через ___, так как дом, где она жила, находился в городской стене.
cases.translation: She let them down by a cord through the window, for her house was on the side of the wall.
cases.explain: The preposition через (through) governs the accusative case.

reading.ru: Иисус, сын Навин, тайно послал из лагеря, расположенного в Шитиме, двух лазутчиков.
reading.question: What did Joshua secretly do from the camp at Shittim?
options: He sent two spies to scout the land
He prepared to cross the Jordan River
He organized the people for battle
He built an altar to the Lord
reading.correct: He sent two spies to scout the land
reading.explain: The text states 'Иисус... тайно послал... двух лазутчиков' — Joshua secretly sent two spies.

reading.ru: Они отправились и пришли в дом блудницы по имени Раав и остались там ночевать.
reading.question: Where did the spies go and what did they do?
options: They came to the house of a prostitute named Rahab and spent the night there
They went to the king's palace
They built a camp near Jericho
reading.correct: They came to the house of a prostitute named Rahab and spent the night there
reading.explain: The text says 'пришли в дом блудницы по имени Раав и остались там ночевать' — they came to Rahab's house and stayed to sleep there.

reading.ru: Но женщина спрятала тех двоих мужчин, она сказала, «Да, ко мне приходили эти люди, но я не знала, откуда они».
reading.question: How did Rahab help the spies when the king demanded them?
options: She hid the men and told the king she didn't know where they were from
She gave the men to the king
She told the men to escape immediately
She helped the men fight the king's servants
reading.correct: She hid the men and told the king she didn't know where they were from
reading.explain: Rahab hid the spies and deceived the king by saying 'я не знала, откуда они' — I didn't know where they were from.

reading.ru: Я знаю, что Господь отдал эту землю вам, и великий страх перед вами охватил нас, всех жителей этой страны охватил ужас перед вами.
reading.question: What did Rahab tell the spies about the people of Jericho?
options: She said the Lord had given them the land, and great fear of them had seized the inhabitants
She said the king was very powerful
She said the people would welcome them
She said the walls were too strong to breach
reading.correct: She said the Lord had given them the land, and great fear of them had seized the inhabitants
reading.explain: Rahab confesses 'Господь отдал эту землю вам, и великий страх перед вами охватил нас' — the Lord gave you the land and fear has seized us.

reading.ru: Итак, пожалуйста, поклянитесь мне, Господом, что вы проявите милость к моей семье, как я проявила милость к вам.
reading.question: What did Rahab ask the spies in return for her help?
options: To swear by the Lord to show kindness to her family as she had shown kindness to them
To give her gold and silver
To take her to their camp
reading.correct: To swear by the Lord to show kindness to her family as she had shown kindness to them
reading.explain: Rahab says 'поклянитесь мне, Господом, что вы проявите милость к моей семье, как я проявила милость к вам' — swear by the Lord to show kindness.

reading.ru: Она спустила их по веревке через окно, так как дом, где она жила, находился в городской стене.
reading.question: How did Rahab help the spies escape from Jericho?
options: She let them down by a cord through the window, since her house was on the wall of the city
She opened the city gate for them
She gave them horses to escape
She distracted the guards while they left
reading.correct: She let them down by a cord through the window, since her house was on the wall of the city
reading.explain: The text states 'Она спустила их по веревке через окно' — she let them down by rope through the window.
